text: {"name":"rf_check_trim","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Conditionally performs an IRQ/MMIO operation, reads the selected 140-byte trim record's words at offsets 128 and 124 into the output pointers, and returns the high bit of their subtraction (offset 124 minus offset 128).","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a2":"value_128_out","a3":"value_124_out","v6":"trim_record","v7":"value_124"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":1224,"meaning":"Context byte gating the conditional IRQ/MMIO operation"},{"offset":1225,"meaning":"Index selecting a 140-byte trim record"},{"offset":124,"meaning":"First comparison value, also written to the second output pointer"},{"offset":128,"meaning":"Second comparison value, also written to the first output pointer"}]}
